description: The pet's popup (10/14): for one dropped file that waits for the user, it may read the app state, the drop queue, an operation, folders, a plan and an action; answer the question, choose a folder, build, cancel and apply a plan, go on with or cancel the drop; for a file the automatic mode just moved (the moved note, 10/17), take that drop's ID and undo the move after a preview of where it goes back (organize-spec §8); change its own size, hide itself, be dragged by its top line, and show the main window. Nothing else: no agreeing to send, no authorizing a source folder, no pickers, no settings, no Memory, Source or Find, no event listening, no plugin.
